_id.description: Unique identifier of the document. Pattern: <packagingSpecificationId>-L<nnn>

recordNo.description: Business identifier of the document, readable by people and unique within the site

siteId.description: Reference to u_mes_mdm_site._id: the site the document belongs to

siteName.description: Display value of the site, copied from u_mes_mdm_site.name

packagingSpecificationId.description: Reference to u_mes_mat_packagingSpecification._id: the parent document this one belongs to

packagingSpecificationName.description: Display value of packagingSpecificationId, copied from u_mes_mat_packagingSpecification.recordNo

packTypeName.description: Display value of packTypeId, copied from u_mes_mat_packType.name

quantity.description: Quantity of the packaging specification level

schemaVersion.description: Version of this collection's document structure, starting at 1
